name: settings-form
title: Settings form
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Grouped cards over a string key-value map, with a sticky save bar, discard, and a beforeunload guard.

meta.descriptionEs: Tarjetas agrupadas sobre un mapa clave-valor, barra fija, descartar y aviso al cerrar la pestaña.

examples.title: Textos de portada
examples.description: Edita el titular. La barra aparece al ensuciar el formulario.

api.name: groups
api.description: Cards. Each field is text, textarea, or url.

api.name: onSave
api.description: Persist the whole map. Discard restores the last values prop.

api.name: StickySaveBar
api.description: Exported for a custom form that wants the same bar.

docs: Labels are props, so the same form can be Spanish or English. The leave message is the beforeunload string.
